name: Instant e-PAN
summary: A free, pre-login service on the e-Filing portal that lets an individual who has not yet been allotted a PAN obtain a digitally signed PAN in electronic form (e-PAN), using their Aadhaar, the mobile number linked to it and DigiLocker.
eligibility: Any individual who does not already have a PAN, has a valid Aadhaar linked to an active mobile number, and has access to DigiLocker. Not eligible: an individual who already has a PAN allotted; a minor as on the date of the request; a person covered under the definition of 'Representative Assessee' under section 160 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, or section 303 of the Income Tax Act, 2025.
steps: On the e-Filing portal homepage, click 'Instant e-PAN' under Quick Links, then click 'Get New e-PAN' on the e-PAN page.

You are redirected to DigiLocker to fetch your date of birth details and supporting proof. If you do not have a DigiLocker account, you can create it during the e-PAN flow using your Aadhaar-linked mobile number for OTP verification.

Select one of the date of birth documents available in your DigiLocker (Driving License, Birth Certificate, Class X marksheet, Class X compartment marksheet, Class X / Matriculation Passing Certificate or Central Govt Health Scheme Card), edit the validity date giving consent to share it with the Income Tax Department, and click 'Allow'.

Validating your email ID is optional. If your email ID is updated in Aadhaar but not validated, click 'Validate Email'; if it is not updated in Aadhaar, click 'Link Email ID'. Then enter the 6-digit OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number and click 'Continue'.
A success message is displayed along with an Acknowledgement Number, which you should note for future reference. A confirmation message is also sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.

To check the status without logging in, go to the e-Filing portal homepage, click 'Instant e-PAN' under Quick Links, then click 'Continue' on the 'Check Status / Download e-PAN' tile. Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number and click 'Continue', then enter the 6-digit OTP received on your Aadhaar-registered mobile number and click 'Validate Aadhaar OTP and Continue'.
If the e-PAN has been generated and allotted, click 'View e-PAN' to view it, 'Download e-PAN' to download a copy, or 'Create e-Filing Account' to register on the e-Filing portal.

After registering on the e-Filing portal, you can also log in with your User ID and password, go to Dashboard > Services > View / Download e-PAN, enter your Aadhaar number and the OTP, and click 'View e-PAN' or 'Download e-PAN'.
